mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_wechat_express_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND request_key=#{requestKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM dms_wechat_express_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_id=#{shipmentId} AND status='SUCCESS' LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM dms_wechat_express_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND shipment_id=#{shipmentId} AND status IN ('SUCCESS','CANCELLING','CANCEL_CONFIRMED','CANCELLED') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_wechat_express_order SET waybill_id=#{waybillId},status='WAYBILL_CREATED',error_code=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_wechat_express_order SET shipment_id=#{shipmentId},status='SUCCESS',error_code=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_wechat_express_order SET status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status <> 'SUCCESS'
UPDATE dms_wechat_express_order SET status='CANCELLING',error_code=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='SUCCESS'
UPDATE dms_wechat_express_order SET status='CANCEL_CONFIRMED',error_code=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='CANCELLING'
UPDATE dms_wechat_express_order SET status='CANCELLED',error_code=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='CANCEL_CONFIRMED'
UPDATE dms_wechat_express_order SET status='SUCCESS',error_code=#{errorCode},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='CANCELLING'
